cases.actual_message: By default, when you gain a card, it goes into your discard pile. You do not play it immediately; gaining and playing are separate actions. A gained card only enters play if you specifically choose to play it during your Action or Buy phase.
cases.review_note: Default gain destination and no immediate play are correct. Extra exclusive Action/Buy-phase claim is not established by the sole actual page-7 citation.

cases.actual_message: Yes, you win if all four diseases are cured, even if cubes remain. The game ends immediately when cures for all four diseases are discovered; eradication is not required to win. Curing a disease means discarding five matching City cards at a research station (or four for the Scientist). Eradication occurs only when a disease is cured and no cubes of that color remain on the board. While cured diseases still allow new cubes to be placed during infections, treating them becomes easier.
cases.review_note: Win and cure/eradication core are correct. Scientist four-card exception is not supported by actual cited pages 4 and 7; it appears elsewhere in supplied evidence but is not actually cited.
